summary: Frontend-only testing of the new Treesh M.A.D. (Manage & Direct) rename + Models feature in /songcoder.html. All review-request scenarios pass end-to-end against the mock GitHub API: title/brand rename, no 'Song Coder' leftovers, Models tab with file-missing notice + empty state, drawer sections, measurement unit toggle (ft/in <-> cm) with correct conversions, preview stats, validation (name, height, no-photo toast, duplicate-name block), photo link-add + batch import (text/HTML, no re-import duplicates), code panel + copy toast, Go-live save producing a correct <article class='model' ...> in content/models.html on the mock, in-place EDIT (waist change persisted, same id), DELETE via confirm modal, Settings models-path default, and mobile 390x844 layout with no page overflow.
critical_code_review_comments: songcoder.html is now ~2910 lines in a single file; models logic (sections, parse/build, drawer, photos, save/edit/delete) is tightly coupled with the rest. Future split into ES modules is worth planning.

data-digitals and data-categories attributes are correctly omitted when empty via the generic add(k,v) helper. If downstream consumers rely on their presence, consider always emitting them (even as empty strings).

model-card child h3 uses data-testid='model-card-name' which prefix-matches 'model-card-'; selector [data-testid^="model-card-"] matches both cards and inner name nodes. Not a bug but worth tightening in future tests.
test_credentials: Mock GitHub token 'testtoken' (any non-empty string). API base https://music-catalog-sync.preview.emergentagent.com/api/mockgh
seed_data_creation: POST /api/mockgh/reset before test. localStorage treesh_songcoder_cfg_v2 seeded with modelsPath content/models.html and mode:'live'. Two models created during test (TEST Avery Nova #1, TEST Bea Luna #2); #2 deleted at end; #1 remains on main.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mock returns 404 for content/models.html until the first model save (create path). Use fetch() inside the browser (page.evaluate) to hit the mock API; direct urllib from the test runner returns 403 due to preview auth. Playwright selector [data-testid^='model-card-'] matches BOTH the card and the inner h3 (model-card-name); prefer a more specific selector like article[data-testid^='model-card-']. Preview card thumbnail background uses the headshot photo (first by default). Measurements conversions: 5'10" -> 177.8cm, 34in -> 86.4cm, 24in -> 61cm (rounded to 1 decimal in code), 35in -> 88.9cm.

validation.missing_height_error: Height is the first thing scouts look for.
